limitations: OSM tags are descriptive context only; no tag confirms the source of a thermal anomaly.
'ok_no_features' means the query succeeded with no matching elements, not that nothing exists; OSM completeness varies and is often lower in rural India.
'failed' clusters have unknown context and must not be treated as 'no features'.
OSM was queried at run time, not during the Jan-Mar 2026 detection window.
The search is centred on the cluster centroid with a fixed radius; multi-cell clusters can extend beyond it.
